name: Gégény (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gégény (a blue shield with a white church, a crescent and ears of grain) below the name GÉGÉNY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
